title: Survey harmonization spec (v1)
description: JSON Schema for src/config/<survey>/harmonize{,_validated}/*.yml. Replaces the imperative validate_harmonize_spec(). The headline guarantee is additionalProperties: false at every object level so typos like 'harmnoize:' or 'vaild_range:' fail loud.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be the integer 1 for this revision.

missingConventions.description: Map of convention-name -> codes. Each value is either an integer/array of integers (short form, brief permits both) or an object with required 'codes' and optional 'description' (long form — the form every production spec actually uses). Both forms are accepted to match the brief and to tolerate jsonlite auto_unbox of length-1 arrays.

waveKey.description: Wave identifier. Surveys use heterogeneous conventions (w1, y1995, r5, w2003, w2025). Pattern admits any lowercase alphanumeric+underscore string starting with a letter.

id.description: Snake-case unique identifier within the spec.

type.description: Variable type. Drives downstream invariant checks (Layer 3). Production specs use ordinal/nominal/continuous as the principal three plus binary (a 0/1 or 1/2 special case of nominal) and categorical (synonym for nominal in a handful of legacy specs).

tags.description: Free-form metadata tags. Accepts a scalar string OR an array of strings — jsonlite auto_unbox collapses single-tag arrays.

source.description: Mapping wave-key -> source variable name (string) or null when the variable is absent in that wave.

scaleBlock.description: Optional scale annotation. min/max are STRONGLY recommended but not required because some KAMOS demographic vars (sex, marital status) ship with `labels` only and no numeric range.

labels.description: Optional map of code -> human-readable label. Code keys are stringified numerics (YAML int keys serialize to JSON strings).

direction.description: Free-form direction annotation (e.g. 'higher_more_trust'). Documentary; not enforced by the engine.

missingOverride.description: Per-variable override of missing handling. Either references a key in top-level missing_conventions via use_convention, or supplies codes directly, or both (codes are appended).

harmonizeBlock.description: Wave-rule resolution map. Reserved keys are 'default', 'by_wave', and 'exceptions'. Any other key MUST be a wave key (direct-wave-key form) and resolves to a rule object. Note: AJV applies both `properties` and `patternProperties` when both match a key, so we cannot use a generic wave-key pattern alongside the reserved keys without conflict. Instead, every non-reserved key falls through to `additionalProperties`, which is a harmonizeRule subschema; that constrains direct-wave-key shape to a rule object while still rejecting genuinely unknown sub-keys via the rule's own `additionalProperties: false`.

harmonizeRule.description: A single transformation rule. method may be null to indicate 'do nothing' (treat as not-mapped). Required field is 'method'; everything else is method-specific or annotation.

mapping.description: For method=recode. Map raw-code (string-keyed integer) -> harmonized-code (integer or null).

sources.description: For method=derive. List of raw variable names the derive function consumes.

validate_all.description: Optional regex phrase the source-variable label must match for this wave (semantic-label assertion enforced inside the recoding helper).

treat_as_na.description: Per-variable extra missing codes (KINU pattern). Engine appends these to the convention codes.

gated_waves.description: Waves to which a gate question (skip-pattern parent) routes; respondents not routed here have structural missingness rather than data loss. Numeric wave codes (e.g. years).

waves.description: List of wave keys this validate rule applies to. Accepts a scalar wave-key string OR an array; jsonlite::toJSON(auto_unbox=TRUE) collapses length-1 arrays to scalars, so the schema must tolerate both shapes without changing the YAML's intent.

intOrIntArray.description: Number or array of numbers. Almost always integer in practice, but IPUS-NK uses fractional missing codes (2.5/4.5 from KOSSDA between-answers). jsonlite::toJSON(auto_unbox=TRUE) collapses length-1 numeric arrays to scalars; the schema must accept both shapes since YAML authors write `codes: [9]` and `codes: 9` interchangeably.
